candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Whiskeytown Lake is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1). Landlocked salmon (kokanee) are likewise open all year under §5.41(a).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: General statewide trout limit for inland lakes, reservoirs, and ponds: five-trout daily bag limit and ten-trout possession limit. Applies to trout; kokanee salmon are regulated separately under §5.41.

candidates.summary: 5 trout daily bag limit, 10 trout possession limit

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: Kokanee (landlocked salmon) are regulated under §5.41, separately from trout under §5.85, and are not counted against the trout bag/possession limit. Whiskeytown Lake is not among the §5.41(e) exception waters (Bucks Lake, New Bullards Bar Reservoir, Pardee Lake, Trinity Lake), so the default five/ten landlocked-salmon limits apply.

candidates.summary: Kokanee (landlocked salmon): 5 daily bag limit, 10 possession limit — separate from the trout limit

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Whiskeytown Lake (Region 1, Shasta Co.) for fingerling-size Kokanee under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of April-June. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Whiskeytown Lake (Region 1, Shasta Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of March-May. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Whiskeytown Lake (Region 1, Shasta Co.) for sub-catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of March-May. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
